parts.label: b
parts.text:
x, y, m and n are different positive integers with x > y and m > n.
When xy = mn = 6 one solution is
x = 3,  y = 2    and    m = 6,  n = 1.
The substitution of these values into
(x + y)2 + (m – n)2  =  (x – y)2 + (m + n)2  gives these equal sums of square numbers.
52    +      52     =     12       +      72
Find all the possible solutions when xy = mn = 12.
For each solution, write the equal sums of square numbers.
